ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal regions versus 55% low-intensity black pixels in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the outer thirds of both lobes; a primary dark pigmentation mask covers the central area including the notch; numerous white linear and punctate disruptions are mapped within the dark central field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 82 degrees at the vertex, with a depth ratio of roughly 1:6 relative to total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing margin, with increased amplitude near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upward-projecting tips; the leading edge exhibits a smooth convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacle attachment points) localized on the outer margins and tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the central dark pigmentation and the transition zones to the white distal areas.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the ventral surface and visible barnacle colonization on the distal trailing edges.
